description: Self-delivery table (decision 0005): the trimmed linear machine Brokkr uses to deliver changes to itself. One seat per phase; verification is the repo's own test suites, not a stack boot. The constitutional review/security invariants from the production table are intact: review is unavoidable on every path to done, security-hold is a hard stop, and a security residual never slips onto the tracked-debt path unanswered — under decision 0022 it sends the run BACK to implement, at most twice, and the exhaustion ladder then stops, parks, or ships it as named debt.

rules.reason: Task framed against the repo and recorded.
Two consecutive broken implement runs; stop and report rather than thrash.
First broken run; one re-run with the specific gap named is permitted.
Implementer blocked; report the blocker, never silently continue.
A returned implement changed only declared docs; review the answer without rerunning code verification (decision 0041).
Implementation complete and committed.
Verification is still red after three implement visits; stop at the bound.
Return the failing output to the implementer (decision 0041).
Full suite green; reviewers read verified code.
Unresolved high-severity security findings. NEVER ship. Risk acceptance is the operator's, never an agent's.
Two reforgings spent and the security residual is still above medium; the machine tried, and now the piece is the operator's (decision 0022).

Two reforgings spent and a medium security residual survives; the run parks awaiting the operator, the residual as its reason, so the ruling lands inside the run's journal instead of after its death (decision 0022).
Two returns spent; a positively low or info residual ships as tracked debt named in the notes. Silence never earns this arm (decision 0041).
A residual above low, in any dimension, returns to implement while the bounded heats remain (decision 0041).
A low or info residual proceeds only as tracked debt named in the notes.
Review clean and no code changed; verification evidence stands.
HEAD moved after the review verdict; re-arm a scoped review (security rides along) before shipping.
A dirty worktree at ship time is a defect: seats commit their work.
Gates passed and ledger written; confirm close-out and report shipped.
HEAD moved between ready and close-out; re-arm a scoped review (security rides along) before shipping.
A dirty worktree at close-out is a defect: seats commit their work.
Close-out confirmed: clean tree, review concluded, verification green, no drift. The operator pushes and merges.
